messages:
maria: PR #12345 touches kv-cache warmup; we need 2x LGTM + security-owner signoff before 18:00 PT cutoff. CI is green but staging smoke shows a small latency delta — can someone pick this up?

dmitri: on it, i'll run a quick perf check and report back in ~20m

lina: can someone ping @security-team? i don't have the perms to request formal signoff from them

chris: i'm in EMEA and won't be able to merge before my afternoon, but i can be backup approver if needed. @dmitri please flag anything risky.

dmitri: ran a quick profile — one run showed p95 +12ms on longer seqs, rerun passed but worth noting. snippet: ```perf: p95 +12ms (1024 seqs), median unchanged```

maria: :warning: +12ms p95 is borderline. cutoff is 18:00 PT (t-45m). if we don't have 2x LGTM + security signoff by cutoff we hold the deploy.

release-sheriff: placing a temporary hold until we get explicit signoffs and the PR description is updated with perf/smoke results. i'll escalate to on-call approvers if needed.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #12345 (build 789)

dmitri: i can LGTM if we add a fallback toggle + auto-fallback rollout policy (so ops can revert without a deploy). left a small comment on the PR with the toggle patch.

lina: filed a quick security review request here: https://redwood.dev/sec/review/987 — @security-team please take a look at cache pointer changes and race surfaces

maria: thanks — @chris if you can be the second eye (in case @dmitri needs to step away) that would help. i updated the PR with the smoke logs and perf snippet.

chris: ok taking a look now :eyes:

dmitri: LGTM — verified smoke with toggle off and fallback works. added ops note to enable feature only in canary initially.

chris: LGTM as well. good to me. @security-team any final objections?

security-team: security-team: quick ack after the review, no high-risk findings, signoff granted

maria: great — we now have 2x LGTM + security signoff. @release-sheriff please remove hold and we can merge within the cutoff window.

release-sheriff: removing hold and marking as approved for merge. thanks everyone — merging now. :tada:
